description: The aide's only hook: every 60 clock cycles (about a minute at 1000 ms a cycle) run aos-frontend aide-tick (aide_tick.json, next to this file). It carries the team's decision files (~/.aos/view/teams/<team>/outbox/) to the relay mailbox ~/.aos/view/mailbox as pass letters, sends a report when the facts changed and a beat every 15 minutes. Nothing enters the history; no brain call. The stock timer and mail_notify hooks are left out on purpose (mail_notify would wake the brain).
